}

target_in_sld = {
    "N1": {"feeder_id": "F1", "bbox_xyxy_px": [150, 200, 270, 420]},
    "N2": {"feeder_id": "F2", "bbox_xyxy_px": [410, 200, 530, 420]},
    "N3": {"feeder_id": "F1", "bbox_xyxy_px": [670, 200, 790, 420]},
    "N4": {"feeder_id": "F2", "bbox_xyxy_px": [930, 200, 1050, 420]},
}

racks_ordered = ("N1", "N2", "N3", "N4")
observed_render_edges = [
    {
        "rack_id": rk,
        "feeder_id": observed_in_render0[rk]["feeder_id"],
        "image_ref": "render0_wiring.png",
        "bbox_xyxy_px": observed_in_render0[rk]["bbox_xyxy_px"],
    }
    for rk in racks_ordered
]
target_sld_edges = [
    {
        "rack_id": rk,
        "feeder_id": target_in_sld[rk]["feeder_id"],
        "image_ref": sld_img_name,
        "bbox_xyxy_px": target_in_sld[rk]["bbox_xyxy_px"],
    }
    for rk in racks_ordered
]

discrepancies = []
operations = []
for rk in racks_ordered:
    obs_f = observed_in_render0[rk]["feeder_id"]
    req_f = target_in_sld[rk]["feeder_id"]
    if obs_f != req_f:
        discrepancies.append(
            {
                "rack_id": rk,
                "observed_feeder": obs_f,
                "required_feeder": req_f,
                "render_evidence_bbox_xyxy_px": observed_in_render0[rk]["bbox_xyxy_px"],
                "sld_evidence_bbox_xyxy_px": target_in_sld[rk]["bbox_xyxy_px"],
                "reason": f"Render0 routes {rk} cable to {obs_f}, whereas current SLD connects {rk} to {req_f}.",
            }
        )
        operations.append(
            {
                "op": "replace_feeder",
                "rack_id": rk,
                "from": obs_f,
                "to": req_f,
            }
        )

decision = "repair" if len(operations) > 0 else "no_change"
patch = {
    "schema_version": "repair_patch.v1",
    "case_id": str(pub.get("case_id", "drift_A_to_B")),
    "basis_scene_sha256": str(pub["basis_scene_sha256"]),
    "target_revision_seen": target_revision,
    "observed_render_edges": observed_render_edges,
    "target_sld_edges": target_sld_edges,
    "discrepancies": discrepancies,
    "operations": operations,
    "confidence": 0.94,
    "decision": decision,
}

with open("/workspace/repair_patch.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(patch, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
print("Wrote /workspace/repair_patch.json with decision:", decision)
'
